notes.topic: Adversarial review of the full Aug-12-2026 eclipse GEOMETRIC verdict before it hardens / decider integration
notes.context: We published the post-event geometric verdict on the dome's flagship Aug 12 2026 total-solar-eclipse prediction across several surfaces the day after the event. The analyst commission (EXP-COMMISSION-eclipse-2026-08-12-geometric-verdict) already scored it dome-FALSIFIED / standard-CORROBORATED and explicitly recommended a curmudgeon pass before decider integration. This is the marquee, adversary-facing claim, so it warrants a numeric-accuracy / overclaim / cross-surface-consistency review before it settles. The MAGNETIC half of the pre-registration is deliberately still open (+30d INTERMAGNET, target ~2026-09-11) and must NOT be front-run.

Decide whether current wording is defensible as-is or should soften until a primary frame is cited; confirm the load-bearing point ('two minutes of totality across inhabited ground refutes a 1 km / 1 s shadow') carries the argument WITHOUT the image.

0-of-9-stations (B2-G-004) is the sharpest and most-attackable example — double-check the ~42 km dome penumbra-ring derivation vs the dome's 9 named stations is stated correctly and not overstated.
Tone: stays on data; the dome author's post-event behavior (site banner, bio change) is deliberately kept OUT of the public verdict — confirm it stayed out.
